input.question: What is the population of Middlesex Township, Pennsylvania?

documents.text: Middlesex Township, Butler County, Pennsylvania Middlesex Township is a township in Butler County, Pennsylvania, United States. The population was 12,450 at the 2010 census. Middlesex Township is located in south-central Butler County, with Allegheny County to the south. The unincorporated communities of Cooperstown and Glade Mills are near the center of the township along Pennsylvania Route 8, which crosses the township from north to south. According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of, of which is land and, or 0.31%, is water. Deer Creek and Bull Creek originate in the southeast section.
